flow.zh: 2017年7月，從蒙古共和國首都烏蘭巴托，飛往蘇聯西伯利亞最大城市 Irkutsk，再乘車前往貝加爾湖畔小鎮 Listvianka。晨起湖邊散步，看白色煙霧，洣濛群樹，旭日浮照清澈湖面，掩映遠方山嶺。隔日往北，乘渡輪抵貝加爾湖最大島Olkhon Island。住宿兩夜， 欣賞沿島風光水色。
flow.en: In July 2017, he flew from Ulaanbaatar, the capital of the Republic of Mongolia, to Irkutsk, the largest city of Siberia in the Soviet Union, and then took a bus to the small town of Listvianka on the shores of Lake Baikal. Take a walk by the lake in the morning to see the white smoke, the trees, and the sunrise floating on the clear lake, covering the mountains in the distance. Go north the next day and take a ferry to Olkhon Island, the largest island in Lake Baikal. Stay two nights and enjoy the scenery along the island.

points.zh: 貝加爾湖，古時稱之為「北海」，17世紀20年代的沙皇俄國探索者稱之為「聖海」，位於西伯利亞南部，距離蒙古共和國北邊邊界111公里，是世界年代最久的湖伯，爲世界第七大湖。曾是中國北方遊牧民族主要活動地區，漢朝蘇武被放逐牧羊之地。貝加爾湖呈新月形，長680公里，最寬處80公里，最深處1637公尺，有多達336條河流注入，是世界最深的湖，也是世界儲水量最大的淡水湖，其儲水量相當於北美洲五大湖之總量。湖中生物資源豊富，湖水透明高，水質清澈，有「西伯利亞明珠」之稱。俄國作家契訶夫曾描寫道:「 湖水清澈透明，就像透過空氣一樣，一切都歷歷在目，溫柔碧綠的水色，令人賞心悅目….。」湖畔峭壁高聳，奇石怪岩林立，景色綺麗，有300多處溫泉，是俄國東部最大的休閒養生之地。貝加爾湖有逾1,700種動物及植物棲息其中，而且一半以上為特有種，1997列入世界人類文化和自然遺產保護名單。
points.en: Lake Baikal, called the "North Sea" in ancient times and the "Holy Sea" by Tsarist Russian explorers in the 1720s, is located in southern Siberia, 111 kilometers from the northern border of the Mongolian Republic. It is the oldest lake in the world and the seventh largest lake in the world. It used to be the main activity area of nomadic people in northern China, and Suwu in the Han Dynasty was exiled to the land of sheep herding. Lake Baikal is a crescent-shaped lake with a length of 680 kilometers, a maximum width of 80 kilometers, a maximum depth of 1,637 meters, and as many as 336 rivers. It is the deepest lake in the world and the world's largest freshwater lake. Its water storage is equivalent to the total of the Great Lakes in North America. The lake is rich in biological resources, the lake is highly transparent, and the water quality is clear. It is known as the "Pearl of Siberia". Russian writer Chekhov once wrote: "The water of the lake is clear and transparent, just like through the air, everything is visible, the gentle and green color of the water is pleasing to the eye...." The cliffs on the lake are towering, strange rocks and beautiful scenery. With more than 300 hot springs, it is the largest place for recreation and health in eastern Russia. Lake Baikal is home to more than 1,700 species of animals and plants, more than half of which are endemic, and was included in the World List of Human Cultural and Natural Heritage in 1997.

points.zh: 台灣原住民中具有紋身習俗的族群，分別是泰雅，賽夏，排灣，魯凱，鄒和卑南等族。但在臉上刺青 (人類學家稱之爲「黥面」，「紋面」或「文面」) 的民族只有泰雅族和賽夏族。黥面對這兩族人而言，有着嚴肅的社會功能和倫理規範，是所有族人生命禮儀中不可或缺的，更是族人共同認知的民族識別，在精神和文化上有非凡的意義。
points.en: Indigenous people in Taiwan have tattoo customs, including Taiya, Sai Xia, Paiwan, Rukai, Zou and Bunan. But the only people with tattoos on their faces (anthropologists call them "noodles", "tattoos", or "textures") were the Taeya and Sai Xia. For these two ethnic groups, there are serious social functions and ethical norms, which are indispensable in the life rituals of all ethnic groups, and moreover, the national identity that the ethnic groups jointly recognize has extraordinary spiritual and cultural significance.

points.zh: 《唐吉訶德》(Don Quixote)  是西班牙作家塞萬提斯的作品 (1615) ，被認為是西班牙的文學典範，也是現代西方文學的奠基作品之一。書中主角唐吉訶德是一個瘦小的沒落貴族，戴著破了洞的頭盔，拿著生銹的長矛，騎着疲憊的瘦馬，和僕人桑多行走天下，打抱不平。整個經歷在幻想和現實，在動機善良和行為盲目中進行。是一個集矛盾於一身，既可喜又可悲的人物。其中最精彩的一幕是 : 把風車群當做撲面而來的巨人，而與之大戰一場，卻弄得遍體傷痕累累。
points.en: Don Quixote is the work of the Spanish writer Cervantes (1615), considered a model of Spanish literature and one of the founding works of modern Western literature. The protagonist of the book, Don Quixote, is a tiny falling nobleman, wearing a helmet with a broken hole, holding a rusty spear, riding on a tired thin horse, and walking with the servant Sandor, embracing the world. The whole experience takes place in fantasy and reality, in motivated kindness and behavioral blindness. A contradictory figure, both happy and pathetic. One of the most exciting scenes is: treating the windmills as giants, and fighting against them has caused bodily injuries.

points.zh: 元朝馬致遠《天淨沙。秋思》：「枯藤老樹昏鴉。小橋流水人家。古道西風瘦馬。夕陽西下，斷腸人在天涯。」這首小令很短，一共只有五句二十八個字，全曲無一秋字，却描繪出一幅淒涼動人的秋郊夕照圖，並且婉轉地傳達出旅人愁苦的心境。全曲無一個動詞，却撥動讀者惆悵悲涼的情懷。全曲景中有情，情中有景，構成一種動人的情景交融境界，展現了元朝曲詞的藝術特徵。
points.en: Yuan Dynasty Ma Zhiyuan "Tianjingsha. Qiusi": "The old withered vine tree dazes the raven. Xiaoqiao Liu Shuiren's home. Ancient Dorsey style slim horse. As the sun set, the intestines were severed." This little order is very short. There are only five sentences and 28 words in total. There are no autumn words in the whole song, but it depicts a bleak and moving picture of the autumn suburbs and the evening, and tacitly conveys the sad mood of guests. The whole song does not have a verb, but it stirs the reader's sad feelings. There are emotions and scenes in the whole music scene, which constitutes a moving scene blending realm and shows the artistic characteristics of the lyrics of the Yuan Dynasty.

points.zh: 《晚禱》是法國畫家米勒 (Jean-Francois Millet, 1814-1875) 的名畫，描繪兩位務農夫婦聽到向晚的鐘聲，虔誠低頭禱告的情景。遠處有教堂尖塔，聳立在黃昏的田野上，兩人的剪影凸顯於斜陽餘暉的背景中。《晚禱》雖然以描繪自然景色為出發點，但是二位人物的姿勢，在畫家筆下，彷彿在頌揚大自然給予人類的恩賜，以及人類謙恭柔順的感恩。米勒以親切的畫風語言，真實地反映農民的難苦勤勞和自足感恩的日常生活。其他的代表畫作有 : 《拾穗》，《播種者》和《牧羊少女》等。
points.en: The Evening Prayer is a famous painting by the French painter Jean-Francois Millet (1814-1875), depicting two farming couples hearing the bells at night and bowing their heads in reverence. In the distance, a church spire rises over a field at dusk, and silhouettes of the two of them stand out against the backdrop of the diagonal sun's afterglow. Although the "Evening Prayer" depicts the natural scenery as the starting point, the posture of the two characters, under the painter's pen, seems to celebrate the gifts given by nature to human beings, and the gratitude of human humility and meekness. Miller truly reflected the daily life of the peasants' hard work and gratitude with friendly painting language. Other representative paintings include: "Gleaning", "Sower" and "Shepherdess".

points.zh: 徐志摩筆下《我所知道的康橋》的最後一段: 「一別二年多了，康橋，誰知道我這思鄉的隱憂 ? 也不想別的，我只要那晚鐘憾動的黃昏，沒遮欄的田野，獨自斜倚在軟草裡，看第一個星星在天邊出現! 」
points.en: Xu Zhimo wrote the last paragraph of "Kangqiao as I know it": "It's been more than two years, Kangqiao, who knows the hidden worries of my hometown? I don't want anything else, I just want the dusk when the clock moves that night, the unshaded field, reclining in the soft grass alone, to see the first star appear in the sky!"

flow.caption_zh: Salvador Dali:  The Persistence of Memory.   1931

points.zh: 《The Persistence of Memory》 (記憶的堅持)  (或譯作記憶的永恆，記憶的持續性) 是達利 (Salvador  Dali, 1904-1989) 作品中最有名的一幅，也是20世紀世界繪畫史裡最為人熟悉的名畫之一。畫中以三個柔軟，正在融化變形的鐘錶為主軸。也就是說，這幅畫是以「時間」為主題。鐘錶的融化，意謂著面對時間的流逝，青春歲月的不再，所發出的無力感，而鐘錶的變形，也意謂著，對於時間流逝的不同向度，而有不知所措的感慨。雖然時間的流逝會有記憶留下，畢竟美好的記憶抵不過歲月的凋零。整幅畫給人一種對時間的焦慮和急廹，所產生的憂慮和無奈，以及對記憶是否能堅持和持續，而產生疑慮和恐慌。
points.en: The Persistence of Memory (also translated as the eternity of memory, the persistence of memory) is one of the most famous paintings by Salvador Dali (1904-1989) and one of the most familiar masterpieces in the history of world painting in the 20th century. The painting is based on three soft, melting and deformed clocks. In other words, the painting is about time. The melting of the clock means that in the face of the passage of time, the youthful years are no longer, the feeling of powerlessness emitted, and the deformation of the clock also means that there is an overwhelming feeling for the different directions of the passage of time. Although the passage of time will have memories, after all, good memories can not resist the withering of the years. The whole painting gives one a sense of anxiety and anxiety about time, the anxiety and helplessness that arise, and the doubts and panic that arise as to whether the memory can persist and persist.

points.zh: 唐朝‧牛希濟《生查子》：「春山烟欲收，天淡星稀少，殘月臉邊明。語已多，情未了，回首猶重道: 記得綠羅裙，處處憐芳草。」感情是可以投射的，愛是可以擴大的，會從綠羅裙擴大為「處處憐芳草」。文學和藝術的美，其實也是一種擴大的經驗，我們不知道在生命的那一個時候，會因為一種什麼樣的體驗，而使感情擴大，使愛延續。朱光潛在他的《文藝心理學》一書中，引用過這句子。他認為美學的擴大意義也是如此。
points.en: Tang Dynasty · Niu Xizi "Shengchazi": "Spring Mountain is smoky, the sky is faint and the stars are scarce, and the face of the remnant moon is bright. After speaking a lot, he was still unhappy. Looking back, he said," Remember the green skirt, it's full of pity for the grass. "" Emotions can be projected, love can be expanded, and it will expand from green gypsy skirts to "merciful grass everywhere". The beauty of literature and art is actually an enlarged experience. We do not know what kind of experience will expand our feelings and perpetuate love at that time of life. Zhu Guangyin quoted this sentence in his book "Literary and Artistic Psychology". He thinks the same is true of the expanded meaning of aesthetics.

points.zh: 《貝加爾湖畔》曲/詞: 李健。「在我的懷裡，在你的眼裡，那裡春風沉醉，那裡綠草如茵，月光把愛戀灑滿了湖面。兩個人的篝火，照亮整個夜晚。多少年以後，如雲般遊走，那變換的腳步，讓我們難牽手。這一生一世有多少你我，被掩沒在月光如水的夜裡。多想某一天，往日又重現，我們流連忘返在貝加湖畔。就在某一天，你忽然出現，清澈又神秘，在貝加爾湖畔。」
points.en: "Baikal" music/lyrics: Li Jian. “In my arms, in your eyes, where the spring breeze revels, where the grass is green and the moonlight fills the lake with love. A two-person bonfire lights up the night. Years later, walking like a cloud, the pace of change makes it difficult for us to hold hands. How many of you and I in this lifetime are hidden in the moonlight like water night. Thinking about one day and repeating the past, we flocked back to the shores of Lake Berga. One day, you suddenly appear, clear and mysterious, on the shores of Lake Baikal.”
